The '''Lesser Soulflow Engine''' is a {{Rare}} [[Minions#Upgrades|minion upgrade]] that is unlocked at {{Coll|Enderman Slayer 2|img = t}}. It sacrifices [[Minions|minion]] output for {{Stat|Soulflow}} item production.

== Usage ==
=== Minion Upgrade ===
The '''Lesser Soulflow Engine''' requires {{Coll|Enderman Slayer 2|img = t}} to use.

{{Affected Minions List|upgrade|all}} When it is added to a minion, the minion's output will be reduced by 50%, but the minion will produce {{Item|Raw Soulflow|amount=1}} every {{Green|180}} seconds when player is on the island and every {{Green|185}} seconds when not.

The {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} production cooldown isn't affected by minion speed modifiers. Drop multiplier [[Minion Fuel]]s (like {{Item|Hyper Catalyst}}) do increase the amount of {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} made. Purple particles will appear above minions with a '''Lesser Soulflow Engine'''.

== Trivia ==
* Minions will wait until the next production cycle to generate {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} if the player is on the island.
* A single minion cannot use 2 Lesser Soulflow Engines at the same time.
* If a minion with a {{Item|Budget Hopper}} or {{Item|Enchanted Hopper}} is full while holding a '''Lesser Soulflow Engine''', the produced {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} will be deleted.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HnvfMx-xfx0&t=503s</ref>
* If the '''Lesser Soulflow Engine''' is used for purely getting soulflow, a good choice for minion to use with the upgrade is one that does not fill their storage quickly with their own drops. This leaves more room for soulflow instead. For example:
** {{Item|Inferno Minion}}, which is the slowest minion in the game if not given [[Inferno Minion Fuel]];
** {{Item|Vampire Minion}}, which is the second slowest minion in the game;
** A {{Item|Super Compactor 3000}} with any slow minion whose drops have a second compacted form, e.g. {{Item|Emerald Minion}}, {{Item|Quartz Minion}}, {{Item|Blaze Minion}}.
* If the produced soulflow is used for profit, it is better to use a minion that already makes good profit by itself.
